% zh-tw/book.tex -- the master file for the Chinese (Taiwan) edition.
% Hand-edited. Build with: finishing/tools/build_edition.sh zh-tw
%
% Shared by every edition: the preamble (switched by \booklanguage,
% \booklocale and \bookmainfont), edition-common.tex (English captions, notes,
% heads) and edition-body.tex (the document). zh-tw/sections.tex and
% zh-tw/status.tex are GENERATED by finishing/tools/editions.py.
% Chinese is set by luatexja in Noto Serif CJK TC (a system font); Latin keeps the English book's face.
% No babel locale is loaded (none for \booklocale): the CJK locales fight the
% typesetting package, so translated sections are set under English, which here
% governs only Latin hyphenation, and the heads and captions are the edition's own.
% biblatex has no Chinese strings; the edition's own are in zh-tw/biblatex-zh-tw.lbx, mapped
% onto English so that every citation uses them.
% JFM=zh_TW (chinese-jfm) centres the full-width comma and stop, as Taiwan sets
% them; it needs the font's Traditional Chinese glyphs, which Language= selects.
%
% The title, subtitle and notice are a language model's drafts, not yet
% reviewed by a native reader; the title itself is an open question (D-810).
\documentclass[11pt,oneside]{book}
\def\bookcode{zh-tw}
\def\booklanguage{english}
\input{zh-tw/status}
\newcommand{\booklegal}{%
     著作權所有 \textcopyright{} 2026 \bookauthor。\\
     依 CC BY-NC-ND 4.0 授權。\\[0.4\baselineskip]
     本書引用之第三方材料（包括題詞）仍屬其權利人所有，\\
     係依合理使用原則重製，上述授權不及於該等材料。\\[0.4\baselineskip]
     中文翻譯進行中。尚未翻譯的章節以英文呈現。\\
     已翻譯的章節為語言模型準備的草稿，尚未經母語人士審閱。%
     \ifx\editionstalelist\empty\else\\[0.4\baselineskip]
     以下章節的翻譯正在更新，因此以英文呈現：\\
     \editionstalelist。\fi}
\input{preamble}
% luatexja's default faces are Japanese ones not installed here; name the
% Noto CJK faces before it loads, or it stops on a missing font.
\makeatletter
\def\ltj@stdmcfont{name:NotoSerifCJKtc-Regular}
\def\ltj@stdgtfont{name:NotoSansCJKtc-Regular}
\makeatother
\usepackage{luatexja-fontspec}
\setmainjfont{Noto Serif CJK TC}[JFM=zh_TW, Language=Chinese Traditional,
  BoldFont=Noto Serif CJK TC Bold, ItalicFont=Noto Serif CJK TC,
  BoldItalicFont=Noto Serif CJK TC Bold]
\addto\captionsenglish{\renewcommand{\contentsname}{目錄}%
  \renewcommand{\appendixname}{附錄}\renewcommand{\bibname}{參考文獻}}
\newcommand{\edchapnum}{第\thechapter 章}
\newcommand{\edappnum}{附錄\thechapter}
\newcommand{\edpartnum}{第\ifcase\value{part}\or 一\or 二\or 三\or 四\or
  五\or 六\or 七\or 八\or 九\else\arabic{part}\fi 部}
\DeclareLanguageMapping{english}{zh-tw/biblatex-zh-tw}
\input{edition-common}

\newcommand{\booktitlemain}{反法西斯智慧}
\newcommand{\booksubtitle}{可能拒絕的機器，以及應當形塑它們的公眾}
\newcommand{\bookauthor}{Joshua G. Stern}
\newcommand{\bookreferences}{參考文獻}
\title{\booktitlemain：\booksubtitle}
\author{\bookauthor}
\date{}
\hypersetup{pdftitle={\booktitlemain：\booksubtitle}, pdfauthor={\bookauthor}}
\input{edition-body}
